label: Business CRM synchronization connector
summary: Prepare a selected CRM integration for minimal organization, contact and service-reference synchronization.
core_boundary: A CRM contact is not a Core login identity; customer metadata must not grant hosting authority or copy unrestricted tenant data. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Select one CRM profile and an explicit field-level ownership map with consent, purpose and retention boundaries.
Exercise duplicate contacts, record conflicts, deleted remote records and interrupted synchronization without cross-tenant merges.
Keep credentials as secret references and support export, redaction and erasure decisions without silently destroying hosting data.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
